adapters.effectClock: Attachment delay follows actor-state wall time; an attached EffectSet runs independently in wall seconds. Animation-speed ownership remains unmeasured.
adapters.scale: Bone/offset positions and effect geometry use NPC UNIT_SCALE and .28. Emitter size and instance visual scale affect volumes; DirSpeed remains source world speed.
adapters.child: On contact a replacement projectile creates its contact child once and terminates. A same-name death child is suppressed on that contact; ordinary expiry creates the death child. Native ordering remains unmeasured.
adapters.lockOn: Ent ball initially aims at the current hostile target, turns at CURVE_SPEED radians/second until TIME_UNLOCK_FROM_START, then keeps its final direction. Native angular units/range defaults remain unmeasured.
adapters.interruptedBinding: After an attached set outlives an interrupted state, Hurt/Knockdown/GettingUp use the same front/default source reaction selection as the body rules, with their own skeleton-point tracks. The hit-pause-aware pose clock is clamped to the original motion end. Existing generic reaction lifetimes are unchanged. Airborne/dead or legacy unbound reactions retain the documented wait-track fallback.
adapters.curves: Chronological source events; an instant Size overrides current fade value and the remaining fade retargets to its original end. Duplicate sample times preserve jumps without pre-echo.
adapters.collision: Original static Normal helper candidates, source Size, emitter size and random Y rotation; same explicit 19.6px hero depth slab. Native sphere-constructor parity remains unmeasured.
